scenarios.name: first-entry
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: BNK1MEO set to LOW-VALUES, the cursor on ACTION (length -1), SEND MAP ERASE; RETURN TRANSID('OMEN') COMMAREA LENGTH(1)

scenarios.name: option-1
scenarios.why: ENTER with action 1 (display customer): EDIT-MENU-DATA accepts it, INVOKE-OTHER-TXNS ends the task with RETURN TRANSID('ODCS') IMMEDIATE -- no map sent

scenarios.name: option-2
scenarios.why: ENTER with action 2 (display account): EDIT-MENU-DATA accepts it, INVOKE-OTHER-TXNS ends the task with RETURN TRANSID('ODAC') IMMEDIATE -- no map sent

scenarios.why: ENTER with action 4 (create account): EDIT-MENU-DATA accepts it, INVOKE-OTHER-TXNS ends the task with RETURN TRANSID('OCAC') IMMEDIATE -- no map sent

scenarios.why: ENTER with action 5 (update account): EDIT-MENU-DATA accepts it, INVOKE-OTHER-TXNS ends the task with RETURN TRANSID('OUAC') IMMEDIATE -- no map sent

scenarios.name: option-6
scenarios.why: ENTER with action 6 (credit / debit funds): EDIT-MENU-DATA accepts it, INVOKE-OTHER-TXNS ends the task with RETURN TRANSID('OCRA') IMMEDIATE -- no map sent

scenarios.why: ENTER with action 7 (transfer funds): EDIT-MENU-DATA accepts it, INVOKE-OTHER-TXNS ends the task with RETURN TRANSID('OTFN') IMMEDIATE -- no map sent

scenarios.name: invalid-action
scenarios.why: action 9: 'You must enter a valid value (1-7 or A).', SEND MAP DATAONLY ALARM, RETURN TRANSID('OMEN')

scenarios.name: lower-case-action
scenarios.why: action 'a': only upper-case A is accepted -- the invalid-value message

scenarios.name: blank-action
scenarios.why: a space typed in ACTION: the invalid-value message

scenarios.name: mapfail
scenarios.why: ENTER with no field modified: RECEIVE MAP is MAPFAIL, the program sends the menu afresh (SEND MAP ERASE), then EDIT-MENU-DATA sees ACTIONI's LOW-VALUES: the invalid-value message is sent DATAONLY too

scenarios.name: pa1
scenarios.why: PA1: CONTINUE -- nothing sent, RETURN TRANSID('OMEN')

scenarios.name: pf3
scenarios.why: PF3: SEND-TERMINATION-MSG (SEND TEXT 'Session Ended' ERASE FREEKB), RETURN

scenarios.name: pf12
scenarios.why: PF12: the same termination message, RETURN

scenarios.name: clear
scenarios.why: CLEAR: SEND CONTROL ERASE FREEKB, RETURN

scenarios.name: other-key
scenarios.why: PF5: WHEN OTHER -- 'Invalid key pressed.', SEND MAP DATAONLY ALARM, RETURN TRANSID('OMEN')

notes: CBSA's main menu (BNKMENU, transaction OMEN, BMS map BNK1ME of mapset BNK1MAI: the symbolic map is generated from src/base/bms_src/BNK1MAI.bms, @bms/BNK1MAI.cpy). Pseudo-conversational: a first task (EIBCALEN 0) sends the menu; a returning one (its 1-byte COMMAREA) acts on the AID -- PA keys do nothing, PF3 / PF12 end the session, CLEAR clears the screen, ENTER reads the action and either starts the chosen transaction with RETURN TRANSID(...) IMMEDIATE or re-sends the menu with a message, any other key re-sends it with 'Invalid key pressed.'. Not reached: the failure branches after RECEIVE MAP (other than MAPFAIL), SEND MAP / SEND TEXT / SEND CONTROL and RETURN -- no fault can be injected on those commands -- and so ABEND-THIS-TASK and the ABNDPROC LINKs.
